issues.explanation: Two new Livewire components ship with no new Pest tests and no unauthorized-call or tamper tests.
Queues and serve routes add no route-level authorization so employee 403 relies only on component mount.
User-input properties have no Livewire validation rules and rely only on domain-action exceptions.
Modal open/close actions resolve scoped models but do not authorize, relying on mount authorization.
Read-only helpers are public Livewire endpoints instead of protected methods.
Invalid mode silently falls back to Any instead of the specified CallMode::from behavior.
Serve render passes duplicate view keys with identical values.
No docs or changelog update accompanies the new pages, routes and lang keys.

conventions.evidence: Uses CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket, policies/Gates, #[Locked] entity, Bulma boxes/modals and {{ }} escaping; deviations: no #[Validate] on name/renameName/mode (Queues.php:65,86; Serve.php:369), public helpers callableQueues/selectedQueue (Serve.php:445,461), no docs sync

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (openCreate/closeCreate/openQueue/closeQueue/startRename/cancelRename/rename/confirmToggle/cancelToggle/toggleActive/openAccess/closeAccess/grantAccess/revokeAccess; callNext), clear names, sibling Blade style, no dead code

requirements.evidence: Queues list openQueue button (queues.blade.php:715), create/rename slug handling (Queues.php:122,193-198), toggle modal with :queue (queues.blade.php:828), scoped findOrFail plus null-safe accessQueue/accessGrants (Queues.php:261-262,289-305), serve callable/mayCall/waiting order/limit (Serve.php:453-459,475-480,497-512), tabs role=tablist (members.blade.php:657); gap: no route can middleware in routes/web.php:998-999

scope.evidence: All hunks serve queues page, serve panel, members tabs, nav dropdown, routes and lang keys; extra lang keys (queues_activate/active/inactive/empty/grant/revoke) support the required UI

security.evidence: Scoped $entity->queues()->findOrFail() and memberships()->findOrFail() on writes (Queues.php:136,163,188,229,240,261-262,275-276; Serve.php:408), null-safe scoped reads, #[Locked] entity/lastCalledTicketId, AuthorizationException uncaught with Inactive/NoWaiting mapped, rate-limit 10/min on success (Serve.php:411-434); gap: openQueue/closeQueue without authorize

simplicity.evidence: Reuses domain actions, QueuePolicy/Gate call checks, existing Bulma row/modal patterns; minor duplication: queues/callableQueues and waitingTickets/tickets aliases in Serve.php:482-489

tests.evidence: No new Queues/Serve tests in diff; only Members/Invite tests adjusted for tabs (EntityInviteTest.php:1015-1022; MembersTest.php:1034,1044-1045,1055-1057) with no unauthorized or tamper coverage

review.summary: Adds Queues and Serve Livewire pages, members tabs, nav links, routes and translations with correct scoped resolution, policies and rate-limiting. Missing new tests plus absent route-level authorization and Livewire validation prevent approval.
